regions.region: page 31 upper and middle sections: 4afb reaction scheme and detailed paragraph
regions.finding: The existing Table 5 entry 13 was enriched with exact 1.0 mmol-scale Pd(acac)2/DPEphos/1a/BSA/2f/Et3B/pyridine/acetyl chloride charges, split DCM carriers, room-temperature 8 h allenylation and 9 h trapping, inherited Typical Procedure IV workup, 60:1 chromatography, 277.7 mg/78% isolated oil, and dr 1.4:1. Table 5 gives 3.0 equiv acetyl chloride while the page-31 scheme/paragraph give 3.2 equiv/3.2 mmol; both remain structured.

regions.region: page 31 lower section: independent 5 mmol 4aab scale-up scheme
regions.finding: The scale-up scheme shows 1a 5 mmol, 2a 1.3 equiv, Pd(acac)2/DPEphos/BSA in DCM under Ar at room temperature for 12 h, acetyl chloride/pyridine trapping for 3 h, and 1.0410 g/83% 4aab. It maps to the existing scale-up record and continues on page 32.

unresolved: The 4afb acetyl-chloride dose differs between shared Table 5 and the detailed page-31 scheme/paragraph.
The scale-up scheme omits Et3B although the page-32 paragraph explicitly includes it.

regions.region: page 32 upper-left continuation of the 5 mmol 4aab scale-up paragraph
regions.finding: Exact scale-up masses/mmol, split 50+25+25 mL DCM charges, 5.0 mmol Et3B, pyridine/acetyl chloride quantities, 60:1 chromatography, and 1.0410 g/83% isolated 4aab enrich the existing scale-up record. The scheme's BSA 1 equiv conflicts with the paragraph's printed 1.0179 g/1.0 mmol on a 5.0 mmol scale and is preserved.

regions.region: page 32 middle and lower sections: 1j to 4ja to 4jab scheme and first-stage paragraph
regions.finding: The existing two-stage acyclic-indole record was enriched with exact stage-1 charges, Ar preactivation for 30 min, room-temperature 12 h reaction, bicarbonate/DCM/brine/Na2SO4 workup, chromatography, 4ja 69.3 mg/35%, and 57% NMR recovery of 1j. The scheme prints catalyst/ligand loadings as 4/6 equiv while the paragraph gives 0.04/0.06 mmol; the conflict remains explicit.

unresolved: Scale-up BSA equivalents versus printed mmol are inconsistent.
The scale-up arrow omits Et3B while the detailed paragraph includes it.
The 1j scheme's catalyst/ligand unit conflicts with the detailed quantities and earlier mol% summary.

regions.finding: Spectroscopic data complete characterization of the 69.3 mg/35% isolated 4ja intermediate; this is continuation of the page-32 first stage, not another preparation.

regions.region: page 33 middle and lower sections: acetylation of 4ja to 4jab
regions.finding: The second stage uses isolated 4ja 69.3 mg/0.35 mmol in DCM 10 mL, pyridine 85 uL/1.05 mmol, and acetyl chloride 50 uL/0.7 mmol at room temperature for 12 h, followed by bicarbonate/DCM/brine/Na2SO4 workup and 20:1 chromatography to give 74.2 mg 4jab in 31% isolated overall yield from 1j over two steps. No unstated stage-2 yield was inferred.

unresolved: The isolated yield of the acetylation stage alone is not reported.
Untimed operation durations and Na2SO4 amounts remain missing.
